name: kimiflare
description: Terminal-native coding agent running on Kimi K2.6 via Cloudflare Workers AI with 262k context, vision inputs, and full agentic loop. Open-source alternative to Claude Code that's cheaper per token and fully transparent.
community_quotes: Built the MVP using Claude Code then built the rest recursively using kimiflare itself woohoo
Open-source claude code / kimi code clone that uses kimi k2.6 using cloudflare workers AI
Cheaper per token than most hosted coding assistants and fully transparent about what it's doing

name: Wrangle
description: Native macOS markdown editor for developers working with Claude Code, Gemini, and AI agents. Features project-level workspace switching, embedded terminals and browsers, smart notifications, and token counting.
community_quotes: Built for the power user who has 15 Claude.md files open right now
The markdown editor that understands CLAUDE.md
Built with Swift so it's snappy fast. No electron app

name: VibeAround
description: Lightweight Tauri desktop app that lets you chat with your local AI coding agent from any IM (Telegram, Slack, Discord) or browser-based web terminal with tmux support. Works with Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI and more.
community_quotes: Turn the IM apps you already use into an interface for your local agent
Works with 7 agents including Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and Codex CLI
Hand sessions between terminal and phone with /handover + /pickup
